set: SS8 People (one portrait per fictional person, shared by every template that shows them)
prompt:
Image 1 is a style reference only: copy its medium, palette, light, colour grading and level of detail. Do not copy its subject or composition.
Use: the portrait of a made-up person in a website template (a conference speaker, a blog author, a designer's about page), shown in a circle from 40 to 96 px, so it must read at small sizes and survive a circular crop.
Subject: a woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and South Asian features, an independent designer of signs and maps.
Details: short black pixie-cut hair, a rust-red jumper, on a pale sage-green background.
Composition: square, head and shoulders, facing the viewer or slightly turned, the head centred horizontally, the face in the centre third, the top of the head about 15% from the top edge, shoulders reaching the bottom edge, nothing important in the corners.
Style: flat illustrated portrait, simple flat colour shapes with soft gouache edges, no outlines, simplified stylised features (small dot eyes, a short curved mouth, a simple nose shape), clearly a drawing and not a real person, warm friendly expression, one plain flat pastel background colour, gentle light from the upper left with one soft shadow tone.
Constraints: no text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border, no photorealism, not a likeness of any real or famous person, nothing in the background.
